feeds.title: Stories From Off The Grid
feeds.description: Read the stories from off the grid from the suburbs to the foothills. The blog is written by Linda Jordan, an eccentric blogger and artist. In 2017, Linda and her family traded manicured suburbs for raw land complete with bears, wild turkeys, and a driveway from the depths of hell itself.

feeds.title: Project Gridless
feeds.description: Hello! Project Gridless is dedicated to off the grid living, foraging / hunting / gardening for food, traditional survival skills and modern tips for alternative energy. This website teaches you about Off the Grid living in Ontario, Canada. Get to know about Off the grid homes, real estate, architecture, gardening, hunting and much more.

feeds.title: Off The Grid News
feeds.description: 'Off The Grid News' is an independent, weekly email newsletter and website that is crammed full of practical information on living and surviving off the grid. Advice you'll never hear from the mainstream media.

feeds.title: RSS Feed
feeds.description: The Accidental Hippies blog tells you how you can build your own house with your own hands. Find all the necessary advices and resources you'd need for starting your homestead. I'm Emily! Together with my husband Mark and our son we built a cordwood house totally off the grid with our own hands. Our goal is to help others learn how to live a simpler, more self-sufficient life.

feeds.title: Evergreen Off-Grid Blog
feeds.description: Welcome to the Evergreen Off-Grid Blog! Come learn to become your own utility. The stakes are too high to rely on a system which is becoming less reliable. You need to take power back into our own hands. We're going to teach you how. Come to Evergreen Off-Grid to find quality posts covering as much content as can reasonably fit in this lane.

feeds.title: Off Grid Survival
feeds.description: An online resource for survival information. From the wilderness and urban survival to emergency preparedness and off-grid living, they provide you with the knowledge you need to survive in any situation. Off Grid Survival is a preparedness/survival website that is dedicated to helping people become more self-reliant and better prepared to face the very real threats that exist in today's world.

feeds.title: Off Grid Living
feeds.description: Off Grid Living is all about living off the grid, sustainable living, homesteading, prepping, survival, solar power, wind power, renewable energy, permaculture, hydroponics, recycling, DIY projects, and natural building. Basically, all topics related to helping clean up the Earth and sustainable living.

feeds.title: Frugal Off Grid Blog
feeds.description: Learn to build a frugal and sustainable homestead. Building a homestead on a budget can be challenging but it's possible to create your own off the grid oasis. Read blogs and watch videos focused on everything it takes to get started with very little. Set up systems for food water and shelter. My mission is to live as frugal and sustainable as possible. I only make products that will add value to your life.

feeds.title: Off Grid and Free
feeds.description: Practical advice for off-gridders, homesteaders, preppers. 40 years off-grid homesteading experience. Check out the blog, videos, podcasts, books and more. Ron Melchiore is an Outdoorsman/Pioneer, Homesteader, Remote Exploration Camp Manager and Author. Living off grid since 1980, Ron and his wife Johanna have spent the better part of their lives 'unplugged.'

feeds.title: An Off Grid Life Blog
feeds.description: Tips, tools and tales of our off grid life in Canada's far north. An Off Grid Life helps readers learn about homesteading, homeschooling, and self-reliance off the grid. It includes stories from our life off the grid in the Northwest Territories of Canada.

feeds.title: Sovereign Survival » Off Grid Living
feeds.description: We're fascinated by all things preparedness. That's why we started this site. While we don't know everything about survival, we want to share the things we do learn. We're a group of people who have always been interested in the outdoors. Everything from camping, hiking, mountain biking, fishing, we loves it all and we're here to share what we know.

feeds.title: Off Grid World
feeds.description: Off Grid & Sustainable Living is your guide to living off the grid, sustainable homes, growing food, and more. Off Grid World is about living off the grid, sustainable living, homesteading, prepping, survival, solar power, wind power, renewable energy, permaculture, hydroponics, recycling, DIY projects, and natural building.

feeds.title: Off-Grid.Net
feeds.description: Off-Grid reports on the people, technologies, events and influences throughout the global off-grid community. The Landbuddy section helps you find others to go off-grid with and the free classifieds are full of ads for off the grid real estate as well as personals and jobs. We have the best lonely hearts columns in the off-grid world.

feeds.title: Living Off Grid - 45.05 N, 77.85 W
feeds.description: This blog is about our life Off The Grid as well as our travels in our converted Cargo Trailer. Read about our travels in our solar powered 'Airstream' and living off grid, in our passive solar home, near Bancroft, Ontario, Canada. We are Art and Mary, two retired Canadians living in an off grid passive solar home.

feeds.title: Wild Oak Trail » Off Grid Living
feeds.description: Are you someone that prefers off grid living? Check out our blog for the items you'd need while living off the grid. Wild Oak Trail is a dependable and trusted source of off-grid and outdoor living supplies for families across North America. Be it a family camping trip, setting up your off grid oasis, or prepping for an emergency, Wild Oak Trail has everything you'll need to feel safe and prepared for every situation.

feeds.title: Alaska Bush Life, Off-Road, Off-Grid
feeds.description: The life of erstwhile city slickers, now telecommuters in a remote log cabin raising chickens, ducks, rabbits, and bees, making beer and wine, and raising vegetables and berries. My husband and I, Laura Emerson, live in a little log cabin in Alaska, a 20 minute flight to the nearest major road. Certifications in Permaculture, Master Gardening, Master Naturalist, and Herbalism have all taught me skills and insights that enhance our remote life.

feeds.title: The Smart Survivalist » Living Off The Grid
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Alex, and I am the person behind The Smart Survivalist blog. I am passionate about survival skills and challenges, off-the-grid living, hiking, camping and preparing, always preparing. I do my best to bring you the most correct, up-to-date and comprehensive information on these topics. Check out my blog to know more about living off the grid.

feeds.title: Off The Grid With A Kid Blog
feeds.description: Inspiring single mom and son work, live and travel in a campervan. Get to know about life in an RV and off the grid. Hi, I'm Bionca and I have an 11 yr old son named Carter. I'm a cultured high energy globetrotting life coach, public speaker and soon to be an author. In October 2017, we decided to buy a van to live in that would enable us to work, home school, explore the world and give back!

feeds.title: Off Grid Installer Ltd Blog
feeds.description: Find out about the various places you can live off the grid and have a good supply of power with Off Grid Installer Ltd. Off-Grid Installer are proud to bring you the best solar products, sourced only from the world's leading manufacturers.

feeds.title: Off Grid Adventure Blog
feeds.description: Here you can find educational content on off grid living and adventures. Off Grid Adventure is the first adventure destination in North America to offer a comprehensive range of indoor and outdoor adventure activities, while also providing education on Off-Grid living.

feeds.title: Medium
feeds.description: Read writing from Up North and Off Grid on Medium. Off Grid at 63 degrees north in Finland. Every day, Up North and Off Grid and thousands of other voices read, write, and share important stories on Medium. In the Up North and Off Grid blog, I aim to gather all the lessons learned, the technology choices, the decisions, in one place.

feeds.title: Off Grid CTO Blog
feeds.description: Stay up to date about living in a cabin off the grid. Get to know how I secure network and much more. My name is Jim Olsen, and this year my wife and myself decided to move to our off grid cabin full time. Previously, we could not attempt this, but the world has changed in ways we could not have expected, and my travel schedule has been heavily modified to say the least.

feeds.title: Off Grid Cabin
feeds.description: This blog is about the design and construction of an off-grid system in Upper Michigan. The purpose of the Off Grid Cabin is to contribute to the off-grid community by basically saying, 'well, that worked out pretty well' or, 'well, that wasn't such a good idea. I think next time I'd...'

feeds.title: Off Grid Living Blog
feeds.description: Beginner's Guide to the Top Tips, Tricks, and Strategies for Living Off the Grid. Get to know about research on off the grid living, how living off the grid works in various states, off the grid projects, articles and much more.

feeds.title: Off Grid Blog
feeds.description: The Off Grid Blog is a one-stop-shop for off-grid living advice. You'll learn about food, gardening, sustainable homes, solar systems and more. We at Off Grid Blog fell in love with the off-grid life after long days of daydreaming about the freedom it offers, the challenges it pushes it to overcome, and the positive environmental impact it has on our planet.

feeds.title: Preparedness Advice Blog » Off The Grid
feeds.description: Get all the advice you need on homesteading and living off the grid with the Preparedness Advice Blog. Get to know about how to manage food and water, fire safety and energy resources, and more basic survival tips with Preparedness Advice.

feeds.title: Offgrid Life
feeds.description: Offgrid Life is a blog for Learning to Live off the Grid. Get to know about setting up solar power panels, learn how to grow your own organic food supply and much more advice. Here we are learning to live off the grid with Solar, Wind and Geothermal Energy. This is a sort of catalog of everything we have learned as we begin the process of living off the Grid.

feeds.title: Off Grid LIiving Blog
feeds.description: Check out the Off Grid Living Blog to know how you can be energy efficient while living off the grid. My name is David Sieg. I'm a normal guy living a normal life in the Mid-West USA. This website is about going off the grid in any environment, urban, suburban, or rural. Once you master the basics, you can go off the grid anywhere.

feeds.title: The Field Lab
feeds.description: This site is about Life off the grid in the SW Texas desert. An experiment in sustainable living. My name is John Wells and I am a Field Researcher. I am currently working on the Southwest Texas Alternative Energy and Sustainable Living Field Laboratory.

feeds.title: WrethaOffGrid
feeds.description: Left the city, going to a mountain in the high desert of far west Texas, built a castle, completely off grid, this is the story of the rest of my life, it starts today. My personal mantra: A goal is a wish with a date attached-Where do you want to be in 1 day-in 1 week-in 1 month-in 1 year?-If you plan nothing, that's exactly what you will achieve.

feeds.title: Tiny Living Life » Living Off The Grid
feeds.description: Find tips on living off the grid with Tiny Living Life. Our goal with Tiny Living Life is to deliver compelling and informational content in the tiny living and off-grid world. Our team is comprised of people who actually walk-the-walk and talk-the-talk. We live and breathe tiny homes and off-grid living. We believe in a future where we spend more time doing the things that inspire us versus accumulating things we don't need.

feeds.title: Off Grid Trailers Blog
feeds.description: Discover our latest posts about the off road trailer lifestyle including tips, travel trailer stories, and industry insights. Off Grid Trailers give you the freedom to explore the backwoods, the rainforests, the great wide open - to truly escape civilization, to fully engage with nature, and to wholeheartedly connect with each other. Be a renegade, go all-in, build memories with an Off Grid Trailer.

feeds.title: Off-Grid.info Blog
feeds.description: Off Grid Info blog provides useful resources for people who live off the grid, what to do in emergency situations, and how to prep for unexpected disasters. This site is an exploration of ideas related to 'off-grid living' - encompassing not only off-grid power, but also other forms of self-sufficiency such as growing your own food and building your own home.
